0022600026.text: The Hornets (3-6, 9th in the East) host the Celtics (6-2, 3rd in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, Charlotte's 10th of the season, as they try to snap a five-game losing streak while holding a 2-3 home record. Charlotte is without Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness), while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest), and Payton Pritchard is day-to-day with an eye abrasion and a game-time decision. The Hornets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 113-102 loss in Boston on April 7, 2026, and the teams have not yet met in 2026-27.
